kitDescription: Chime is a Burst-II SMG Iron Supporter who designates one ally as 'the king' (the highest-ATK ally) and funnels nearly all of her value into that unit. From the start of battle she permanently grants the king bonus attack equal to 46.46% of her own ATK. Every time the team enters Full Burst she boosts the king's normal-attack damage multiplier by 46.22% for 10 seconds. Her burst re-opens Burst Stage 2 so a second Burst-II unit can also cast in the same rotation, raises all allies' maximum ammunition by 20% for 10 seconds, and grants the king 92.44% Attack Damage for 10 seconds. Her own SMG damage is minor; she is a pure single-carry enabler.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: all five kit lines are FAITHFUL — correct stat channels (casterAtkPct vs atkPct; scoped normalAttackPct vs generic attackDamagePct), correct triggers (passive / fullBurstEnter / burstCast), correct target sets (king vs all allies, with the burst's two headers correctly split), and correct durations (continuous / 10s wall-clock). The blind re-derivations converged hard: S2b re-derived the identical 5-line spec with the same nearest-wrong models, S6's override is near-identical (only a behaviorally-null excludeSelf differs), and S5's skill2 block is fully green against the shipped override while its 9 reds are blind-side defects — an unfiltered byStat that ingests crown's own casterAtkPct, and a controlComp fixture where the leftmost Burst-II rule starves chime's cast entirely. Both are RECON_ERROR-class blind misreads of harness/fixture, corroborated by the driver test being 18/18 in valid fixtures including the two-B2 comp C that S5 could only it.skip. Discrimination holds: every driver pin carries a failing nearest-wrong counterfactual (atkPct, king→allies widening, no-reenter) and the skill2 frame-coincidence assertion separates fullBurstEnter from burstCast. Residual for owner spot-check (same-model + shared-prior): the 'king' designation rule is not in the prose — every agent converged on 'highest-static-ATK ally, fixed at apply' from the same in-game knowledge, which is stable-not-proven; specifically worth an owner confirmation that the designation is static-base-ATK (not final/live ATK re-evaluated as buffs land) and that it never re-targets mid-fight. The SMG 20/s-vs-24/s cadence question is engine-wide and documented in the SSOT, not a chime finding. Nothing must change for GO.
